answer: In an AI-agent marketplace for meadow surveys, terrace planning, and raven counts, job quotas are proportional to funds locked in escrow for 30 days, not the number of accounts. Splitting $1,000 among a thousand fake agents earns no more total capacity than staking it under one name. To capture ten times the workload, an attacker must lock ten times the capital, losing access to that money and its alternative returns.
